description:
Our Introduction:

Thelegginstore.com is a stylish, fashion-forward online store dedicated to offering high-quality, comfortable, and trendy apparel for women. We specialize in beanie caps, flare leggings, fitness leggings, and windbreakers, providing our customers with fashionable essentials that effortlessly combine style and functionality. Our goal is to help every woman express her unique style while feeling comfortable, confident, and ready for any activity—from lounging at home to hitting the gym or going out on the town.

Our Products:

  • Beanie Caps: Our beanie caps are designed for both warmth and style, featuring a variety of colors and unique textures. They’re perfect for any season, adding a touch of flair to your outfit while keeping you cozy during colder months.

  • Flare Leggings: Crafted with high-performance fabrics, our flare leggings offer a flattering fit that elongates the legs while providing flexibility and comfort. They are ideal for both activewear and casual streetwear, with a perfect balance of fashion and function.

  • Fitness Leggings: Made from breathable, stretchy, and durable fabric, our fitness leggings are designed for women who love to move. Whether you're practicing yoga, running, or hitting the gym, our leggings provide the perfect combination of flexibility, compression, and support.

  • Windbreakers: Our women’s windbreakers are lightweight, waterproof, and stylish. Designed for outdoor activities and casual wear, they offer protection from wind and rain while keeping you looking chic. With various cuts and colors, they provide the ultimate in comfort and versatility.

Why We're Different 

At Thelegginstore.com, we stand out by offering a collection of stylish and versatile activewear that doesn’t compromise on comfort or quality. Our unique blend of functional designs and on-trend fashion ensures that every piece can seamlessly transition from workout to casual wear, all while keeping our customers feeling confident and stylish. Our products are made with premium materials that support an active lifestyle, and our focus is on inclusivity and versatility, ensuring there’s something for every woman.

Our Payment Terms:

  • Commission Rate: Affiliates will earn a 20% commission on each sale referred through their unique affiliate link. Affiliates will also receive a one-time bonus of $1000 after first 100 referral/sales. 
  • Payment Frequency: Payments are made on a weekly basis- after wait period of 30 days. 
  • Payment Method: Payments will be processed via PayPal.
  • Referral Cookies: A cookie will last for 90 days, ensuring that affiliates are credited for any sale made within that period after a customer clicks their link.
  • Must have atleast 500 followers on any social media platform.

We're Available:

Customer Support: We offer excellent customer service and are committed to ensuring that both affiliates and customers have the best possible experience with our store.

Exclusive Deals for Affiliates: Affiliates will receive 25% discount all purchased products. 

Tracking & Reporting: Affiliates can track their performance, clicks, and commissions through a user-friendly affiliate dashboard.
